production.name: report_groups
production.view_definition:
WITH grouped AS (
         SELECT r.content_type,
            r.content_id,
            (array_agg(DISTINCT r.community_id))[1] AS community_id,
            (array_agg(DISTINCT r.content_author_id))[1] AS content_author_id,
            (array_agg(DISTINCT r.content_title))[1] AS content_title,
            count(*)::integer AS report_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'pending'::text)::integer AS pending_count,
            min(r.created_at) AS first_reported_at,
            max(r.created_at) AS last_reported_at,
            array_agg(DISTINCT r.reason) AS reasons,
            array_agg(DISTINCT r.reporter_id) AS reporter_ids,
                CASE
                    WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'pending'::text) > 0 THEN 'pending'::text
                    WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'removed'::text) > 0 THEN 'removed'::text
                    ELSE 'dismissed'::text
                END AS status
           FROM content_reports r
          GROUP BY r.content_type, r.content_id
        ), live AS (
         SELECT 'thread'::text AS content_type,
            t.id AS content_id,
            t.title,
            t.user_id,
            t.community_id
           FROM community_threads t
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'showcase'::text,
            p.id,
            p.title,
            p.user_id,
            p.community_id
           FROM community_showcase_posts p
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'resource'::text,
            r.id,
            r.title,
            r.user_id,
            r.community_id
           FROM community_resources r
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'event'::text,
            e.id,
            e.title,
            e.user_id,
            e.community_id
           FROM community_events e
        )
 SELECT g.content_type,
    g.content_id,
    COALESCE(l.community_id, g.community_id) AS community_id,
    COALESCE(l.user_id, g.content_author_id) AS content_author_id,
    COALESCE(l.title, g.content_title::character varying) AS content_title,
    g.report_count,
    g.pending_count,
    g.status,
    g.reasons,
    g.reporter_ids,
    g.first_reported_at,
    g.last_reported_at,
    l.content_id IS NOT NULL AS content_exists,
    u.name AS author_name,
    c.name AS community_name,
    rn.names AS reporter_names,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM content_removals cr
          WHERE cr.content_type = g.content_type AND cr.content_id = g.content_id AND cr.undone_at IS NULL)) AS can_restore
   FROM grouped g
     LEFT JOIN live l ON l.content_type = g.content_type AND l.content_id = g.content_id
     LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = COALESCE(l.user_id, g.content_author_id)
     LEFT JOIN communities c ON c.id = COALESCE(l.community_id, g.community_id)
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT
                CASE
                    WHEN r2.reporter_id IS NULL THEN 'Deleted user'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(ru.name, 'Member'::text)
                END) AS names
           FROM content_reports r2
             LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.id = r2.reporter_id
          WHERE r2.content_type = g.content_type AND r2.content_id = g.content_id) rn ON true;

production.name: pgrst_ddl_watch
production.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  cmd record;
BEGIN
  FOR cmd IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
  LOOP
    IF cmd.command_tag IN (
      'CREATE SCHEMA', 'ALTER SCHEMA'
    , 'CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO', 'ALTER TABLE'
    , 'CREATE FOREIGN TABLE', 'ALTER FOREIGN TABLE'
    , 'CREATE VIEW', 'ALTER VIEW'
    , 'CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW', 'ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW'
    , 'CREATE FUNCTION', 'ALTER FUNCTION'
    , 'CREATE TRIGGER'
    , 'CREATE TYPE', 'ALTER TYPE'
    , 'CREATE RULE'
    , 'COMMENT'
    )
    -- don't notify in case of CREATE TEMP table or other objects created on pg_temp
    AND cmd.schema_name is distinct from 'pg_temp'
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$

fresh.name: pgrst_ddl_watch
fresh.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  cmd record;
  obj_schema text;
BEGIN
  FOR cmd IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
  LOOP
    -- triggers and rules have no schema of their own (schema_name is NULL),
    -- so use the schema of the table they belong to
    obj_schema := CASE
      WHEN cmd.object_type IN ('trigger', 'rule')
        THEN (pg_identify_object_as_address(cmd.classid, cmd.objid, cmd.objsubid)).object_names[1]
      ELSE cmd.schema_name
    END;

    IF cmd.command_tag IN (
      'CREATE SCHEMA', 'ALTER SCHEMA'
    , 'CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO', 'ALTER TABLE'
    , 'CREATE FOREIGN TABLE', 'ALTER FOREIGN TABLE'
    , 'CREATE VIEW', 'ALTER VIEW'
    , 'CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW', 'ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW'
    , 'CREATE FUNCTION', 'ALTER FUNCTION'
    , 'CREATE TRIGGER'
    , 'CREATE TYPE', 'ALTER TYPE'
    , 'CREATE RULE'
    , 'COMMENT'
    )
    -- don't notify in case of CREATE TEMP table or other objects created on pg_temp
    -- also exclude any objects inside Supabase schemas
    AND COALESCE(obj_schema, '') NOT IN ('pg_temp', 'auth', 'realtime', '_realtime', 'storage')
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$

production.name: pgrst_drop_watch
production.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_drop_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  obj record;
BEGIN
  FOR obj IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects()
  LOOP
    IF obj.object_type IN (
      'schema'
    , 'table'
    , 'foreign table'
    , 'view'
    , 'materialized view'
    , 'function'
    , 'trigger'
    , 'type'
    , 'rule'
    )
    AND obj.is_temporary IS false -- no pg_temp objects
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$
